#umap


```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(umap)
library(patchwork)

zeta <- read_csv("F:/Florian_paper/Florian/Aligned_Data/Analysable_data/zeta_dir.csv")
Trialless <- read_csv("F:/Florian_paper/Florian/Aligned_Data/Analysable_data/wrangled_Data/R_outputs/Trialless.csv")

list_of_ptt <- list.files(
  path = "F:/Florian_paper/Florian/Aligned_Data/Analysable_data/peak_to_trough_times",
  pattern = "\\.csv$",
  full.names = TRUE
)
ptt <- read_csv(list_of_ptt, id = "id2") %>% as_tibble()

# keys to match the names of the Neruopixels data to the shortfrom M{id}_{session}
translator <- read_csv2("F:/Florian_paper/Florian/Aligned_Data/Analysable_data/translator.csv")

ptt2 <- ptt %>%
  separate(Original_Index, into = c("old", "second_part"), sep = "(?=_row)", extra = "merge", remove = FALSE) %>%
  left_join(translator) %>%
  select(second_part:new) %>%
  select(!Folder) %>%
  separate_wider_delim(second_part, delim = "_", names = c("d1", "d2", "cluster_id")) %>%
  select(cluster_id:new) %>%
  rename(id = new) %>%
  mutate(cluster_id = as.numeric(cluster_id)) %>%
  filter(`Peak_to_Valley (ms)` > 0.16)

Trialless <- Trialless %>%
  left_join(ptt2 %>% unite("cluster_id2", cluster_id, id)) %>%
  replace_na(list(`Peak_to_Valley (ms)` = 0)) %>%
  mutate(newgroup = ifelse(`Peak_to_Valley (ms)` == 0, group, "FS")) %>%
  filter(group != "noise") %>%
  select(Behv:Zscore, newgroup, `Peak_to_Valley (ms)`) %>%
  filter(newgroup != "noise")



zeta2 <- zeta %>%
  unite("cluster_id", unit, Mouse, Day) %>%
  filter(cluster_id %in% Trialless$cluster_id2) %>%
  mutate(Behv = ifelse(Behv == "PC", "UA", Behv)) %>%
  mutate(dircat = ifelse(direction > 0, "increase", "decrease")) %>%
  mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")) %>%
  mutate(dircat = ifelse(p_adj > 0.05, "no_change", dircat))
```

#A
```{r}
zeta_u <- zeta2 %>%
  filter(Behv == "A2L") %>%
  filter(p_value < 0.05) %>%
  pull(cluster_id)
AA <- Trialless %>%
  filter(cluster_id2 %in% zeta_u) %>%
  filter(between(rel_time, 0, 0.500)) %>%
  filter(Behv %in% c("A2L")) %>%
  group_by(rel_time, cluster_id2) %>%
  summarise(Zscore = mean(Zscore)) %>%
  group_by(cluster_id2) %>%
  mutate(Zscore = zoo::rollmean.default(Zscore, 20, "extend")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(cluster_id2) %>%
  mutate(norm = Zscore) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(-Zscore) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = rel_time, values_from = norm)



AA <- AA %>% na.omit()
AA.data <- AA %>% select(-cluster_id2)
AA.data <- t(scale(t(AA.data)))

AA.labels <- AA %>% select(cluster_id2)

# 1. Dimensionality Reduction (Existing)
pca <- prcomp(AA.data, center = FALSE, scale. = FALSE)
plot(cumsum(pca$sdev[1:10]^2 / sum(pca$sdev^2)))
plot(cumsum(pca$sdev^2 / sum(pca$sdev^2)))
AA.pca <- pca$x[, 1:5] # Top 5 PCs

# 2. K-means Clustering
# Set your desired number of clusters (e.g., k = 5)
k_centers <- 4
set.seed(404) # For reproducibility
cl <- kmeans(AA.pca, centers = k_centers, nstart = 25)

# 3. Dimensionality Reduction for Visualization (Existing)
AA.umap <- umap(AA.data, n_components = 2)

# 4. Prepare Plotting Data
plotda <- tibble(
  UMAP1 = AA.umap$layout[, 1],
  UMAP2 = AA.umap$layout[, 2],
  cluster = factor(cl$cluster), # K-means cluster assignment
  cluster_id2 = AA.labels$cluster_id2
)

# Visualize Clusters in UMAP space
plotda <- plotda %>% mutate(cluster = as.factor(cluster))
ggplot(plotda, aes(UMAP1, UMAP2, col = cluster)) +
  geom_point(size = 1, alpha = 0.6) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "K-means Clusters in UMAP Space")
# ggsave('C:/users/Freitag/Desktop/clusteview.svg')


# 5. Join and Plot Temporal Profiles
filt_kmean <- plotda %>%
  select(cluster_id2, kmc = cluster)

# Calculate counts for the facet labels
counts_df <- filt_kmean %>%
  count(kmc)

Trialless %>%
  filter(cluster_id2 %in% zeta_u) %>%
  left_join(filt_kmean, by = "cluster_id2") %>%
  filter(between(rel_time, -0.05, 1)) %>%
  group_by(rel_time, kmc) %>%
  summarise(Zscore = mean(Zscore), .groups = "drop") %>%
  ggplot(aes(rel_time, Zscore, col = as.factor(kmc))) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", span = 0.1, se = FALSE, size = 1.2) +
  facet_wrap(~kmc, scales = "free") +
  geom_text(
    data = counts_df,
    aes(label = paste0("n = ", n)),
    x = Inf, y = Inf,
    hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.1,
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    colour = "black",
    size = 4
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Time (s)", y = "Mean Z-score", col = "Cluster")

# ggsave('C:/users/Freitag/Desktop/meanview.svg')



p1 <- ggplot(plotda, aes(UMAP1, UMAP2, col = cluster)) +
  geom_point(size = 1, alpha = 0.6) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(title = "K-means Clusters in UMAP Space")



# P2 20 ms bins
n_cat <- Trialless %>%
  filter(cluster_id2 %in% zeta_u) %>%
  left_join(filt_kmean, by = "cluster_id2") %>%
  distinct(cluster_id2, kmc) %>%
  count(kmc)
p2 <- Trialless %>%
  filter(cluster_id2 %in% zeta_u) %>%
  left_join(filt_kmean, by = "cluster_id2") %>%
  filter(between(rel_time, 0, 1)) %>%
  mutate(rel_time = floor(rel_time / 0.020) * 0.020) %>%
  group_by(rel_time, kmc, cluster_id2) %>%
  summarise(Zscore = mean(Zscore)) %>%
  left_join(n_cat) %>%
  na.omit() %>%
  group_by(rel_time, kmc) %>%
  summarise(m_Zscore = mean(Zscore), sd = sd(Zscore), sem = sd / sqrt(n), .groups = "drop") %>%
  distinct(rel_time, kmc, m_Zscore, sd, sem) %>%
  ggplot(aes(rel_time, m_Zscore, )) +
  geom_line(aes(col = as.factor(kmc)), linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = m_Zscore - sem, ymax = m_Zscore + sem, fill = kmc), alpha = 0.3) +
  facet_wrap(~kmc, scales = "free") +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(x = "Time (s)", y = "Mean Z-score", col = "Cluster") +
  guides(color = "none")

p2 <- p2 +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_blank(),
    # axis lines
    axis.line.x = element_line(),
    axis.line.y = element_line(),

    # ticks
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_line(),

    # text
    axis.text.y = element_text(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(),

    # tick length (optional, makes them visible)
    axis.ticks.length = unit(0.15, "cm")
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 1))
p2

pp <- (p1 + p2) + plot_layout(, widths = c(1.8, 1))

ggsave("F:/Berlin/figures_v2/Final/Raw_plots_v2/UMAP_fig/A_2.svg", width = 16, height = 9)
```

#B
```{r}
int100 <- Trialless %>%
  filter(cluster_id2 %in% zeta_u) %>%
  filter(Behv == "A2L") %>%
  filter(between(rel_time, 0, 0.1)) %>%
  group_by(cluster_id2) %>%
  summarise(int100 = sum(Zscore) * 0.01) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(rank = dense_rank(int100))


intsus <- Trialless %>%
  filter(cluster_id2 %in% zeta_u) %>%
  filter(Behv == "A2L") %>%
  filter(between(rel_time, 0.1, 0.4)) %>%
  group_by(cluster_id2) %>%
  summarise(intsus = sum(Zscore) * 0.01) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(rank = dense_rank(intsus))

ttp <- Trialless %>%
  filter(cluster_id2 %in% zeta_u) %>%
  filter(Behv == "A2L") %>%
  filter(between(rel_time, 0, 1)) %>%
  group_by(cluster_id2) %>%
  slice_max(Zscore, with_ties = F) %>%
  select(cluster_id2, rel_time) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(rank = row_number(rel_time))

pma <- Trialless %>%
  filter(cluster_id2 %in% zeta_u) %>%
  filter(Behv == "A2L") %>%
  filter(between(rel_time, 0, 1)) %>%
  group_by(cluster_id2) %>%
  slice_max(Zscore, with_ties = F) %>%
  select(cluster_id2, Zscore) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(rank = dense_rank(Zscore))



g1 <- plotda %>%
  left_join(int100) %>%
  ggplot(aes(UMAP1, UMAP2, col = rank)) +
  geom_point() +
  theme_void() +
  scale_color_viridis_c() +
  ggtitle("int100")



g2 <- plotda %>%
  left_join(intsus) %>%
  ggplot(aes(UMAP1, UMAP2, col = rank)) +
  geom_point() +
  theme_void() +
  scale_color_viridis_c() +
  ggtitle("int_sus")


g3 <- plotda %>%
  left_join(ttp) %>%
  ggplot(aes(UMAP1, UMAP2, col = rank)) +
  geom_point() +
  theme_void() +
  scale_color_viridis_c() +
  ggtitle("time to peak")

g4 <- plotda %>%
  left_join(pma) %>%
  ggplot(aes(UMAP1, UMAP2, col = rank)) +
  geom_point() +
  theme_void() +
  scale_color_viridis_c() +
  ggtitle("peak amplitude")




gg3 <- ((g1 + g2) / (g3 + g4) + plot_layout(guides = "collect"))



ggsave("F:/Berlin/figures_v2/Final/Raw_plots_v2/UMAP_fig/B.svg", width = 16, height = 9)
```



#C
```{r}
p1 <- ggplot(plotda, aes(UMAP1, UMAP2, col = cluster)) +
  geom_point(size = 1, alpha = 0.6) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(title = "K-means Clusters in UMAP Space")

metada <- Trialless %>%
  filter(cluster_id2 %in% zeta_u) %>%
  select(cluster_id2, newgroup, Layer) %>%
  distinct()
pplotda <- plotda %>% left_join(metada)


p3 <- ggplot(plotda, aes(UMAP1, UMAP2, col = newgroup)) +
  geom_point(size = 1) +
  theme_void()

# ggsave('C:/users/Freitag/Desktop/scatternewgroup.svg')


p4 <- pplotda %>%
  left_join(metada) %>%
  filter(Layer %in% c("L2/3", "L5")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(UMAP1, UMAP2, col = Layer)) +
  geom_point(size = 1) +
  theme_void()
# ggsave('C:/users/Freitag/Desktop/scatterlayer.svg')


pp2 <- (p3 + p4)
pp2
# ggsave("E:/Berlin/figures_v2/Final/Raw_plots_v2/UMAP_fig/C.svg",width = 16, height = 9)
```
